# Rentile

Rentile is a headless Kotlin Multiplatform dependency that prepares supported map styles and renders north-up XYZ basemap tiles to encoded PNG bytes.

## Documentation

- Home: https://rohittp.com/rentile/
- KMP reference: https://rohittp.com/rentile/kmp.html
- Rendering process: https://rohittp.com/rentile/rendering.html
- Source: https://github.com/rohittp0/rentile
- Architecture decisions: https://github.com/rohittp0/rentile/tree/main/docs/adr

## Public artifact

- Coordinate: com.rohittp.rentile:kmp
- Repository: https://maven.rohittp.com
- Consumer credentials: none
- Historical Maven Central versions: 0.1.0 through 0.1.4
- License: Apache-2.0

## Scope

Rentile targets a versioned basemap compatibility profile validated against an owner-controlled rolling style corpus, uses local CPU rasterization, and always returns PNG tiles. The current development snapshot implements zoom-evaluated backgrounds, raster sources and paint controls, strict MVT decoding, vector overzoom through output zoom 22, the profile's fill/line properties and sprite patterns, remote GeoJSON LineString sources, raster DEM hillshade with neighbor sampling, flattened extrusion footprints, and independent RGBA/SDF icons without text or glyph requests. It does not provide a UI map view, text rendering, perspective extrusion, a platform render loop, or caller policy for batching, priority, retry, fallback, or output caching.
